b: p
highest volume, lowest cost is like your are riding a roller coaster.. your business will be very unpredictable and will be affected by daily market fluctuations. almost like a bit coin trading.
p
you can run highest volume, lowest cost when:
li
if your products are more than 1000 + and many related products to buy together to increase AOV.
li
if your AOV is high enough $100 +
li
if you can create good quality ads and product images(although you have 10000 + items but they are drop shipping products and images are crap, they do not work)
p
if you have only few products like selling candles, few beauty products..etc, you can't scale them with highest volume strategy. it is not for you..
p

* also, after the andromeda update, there are tones of shit traffic when you run highest volume.. it will devour most of budgets in 10 minutes and spits out some shit results. and Meta will say "it is learning phase✌️✌️" CPA gradually, slowly drops over time, but it needs a lot of dollars to be stable. and still it will up and down, ROAS is 10 in the morning, 1.5 in the evening and you will be very happy and sad and smiling and cry every single hours.. You will start acting like a maniac. Your mindset becomes just like that of a day trader or a casino gambler.
p
the only way to make your business safer and predictable, cost cap is the only thing.
p
I have spent $5,000 on highest volume campaign, I lost about $3,000. the average CPA was $30~$50. daily budget was $500. CPA should have to be $10 to make extra $10 every single sales.. but 30~50??
p

I tested both cost cap, daily budget I set $1000. cost cap was $10 and it showed average ROAS of 4~6. CPA was around $7~$10 eventho It does not spent all the daily budget(only 25%), but at least I did not loose any money, and make some profits and it is more stable than the highest volume. do not be greedy, set your business apart from the daily stock trading like market fluctuation.
